notes.title: PERESTROIKA - UPDATE
notes.content:
- Bug fixes -

- Fixed walk animation not working using Arrows/Numpad
- Fixed ability to shoot/reload gun when player escape
- Fixed bug when collecting ammo box and it wouldn't count when the quest was active

- Changes -

- The UI interface was changed
- Pistol shoot sound and shoot animation was changed
- Glass texture was changed
- We added some better tips to the quests so it would be easy to understand what to do
- World lighting was changed and now it looks much better and smooth

- Added -

- Ruble wallet was added to display how many rubles you have
- New particles for different materials when bullet collides object
- New enemies
  • Russian Bear
  • Chechen
  • Milicija
- Added new location - Construction site
- Added 3 new achievements
  • To the moon!
  • Have a nice day!
  • Welcome to Magadan!
- New blood particles
- Added rubles that you need to collect
- Campfire now will heal you by 1 hp each second
- Added a shell particle that fly out of pistol when shooting
- Now the fire in burning house will damage you by 10 hp every second
- Added lights to a car in the cutscene
- Added new shoot particle
- Added new "hand" cursor
